profile: A home cook and allotment gardener who reads about fermentation, growing vegetables and seasonal cooking.

shelf.title: Keeping a Sourdough Starter Alive
shelf.gist: A diary-style piece on the daily ritual of feeding a sourdough starter and why slow fermentation makes better bread.

shelf.title: Why Your Sourdough Starter Has Stalled
shelf.gist: An explainer diagnosing the common causes of a sluggish sourdough starter and how to restart fermentation.

shelf.title: A Baker's Diary: Rye Sourdough in Autumn
shelf.gist: A personal essay on baking rye sourdough through autumn and treating fermentation as part of seasonal cooking.

shelf.title: Two Kimchi Recipes for a Small Kitchen
shelf.gist: A practical how-to comparing a quick and a slow method for making kimchi at home.

shelf.title: The Many Regional Faces of Kimchi
shelf.gist: An essay surveying how kimchi varies by region and season across Korea, and why it belongs to seasonal cooking.

shelf.title: A Fermenting Weekend: Kimchi and Kombucha Together
shelf.gist: A light blog post about spending a weekend making kimchi alongside a batch of kombucha.

shelf.title: From Seed to Sauce: A Year of Growing Tomatoes
shelf.gist: A personal essay following a year of growing tomatoes, saving seeds, feeding the compost heap, and keeping bees on the side.

shelf.title: Pruning and Training Tomatoes in Raised Beds
shelf.gist: A how-to guide on pruning tomato vines grown in raised beds and why soil health underpins the whole method.

shelf.title: Community Garden Reports Bumper Tomato Harvest
shelf.gist: A news-style report on a community garden's tomato harvest, its compost programme and a seed saving swap.

shelf.title: Building Raised Beds Before the Spring Rush
shelf.gist: A how-to guide on building raised beds in late winter, with an aside on the beekeeping that will follow once beds are settled.

shelf.title: Keeping the Compost Heap Working Through Winter
shelf.gist: An essay on maintaining an active compost heap and healthy soil through the cold months, feeding next year's raised beds.

shelf.title: A Practical Guide to Saving Seeds
shelf.gist: A how-to guide on saving seeds from this year's tomatoes and other vegetables to protect soil health and reduce yearly costs.

shelf.title: Keeping Bees Alongside the Vegetable Beds
shelf.gist: An essay on taking up beekeeping at an allotment and folding the honey harvest into seasonal cooking, with soil health as an unexpected benefit.
